df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']

spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 
                 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']

ax1.set_xlabel('Age')
ax1.set_ylabel('Income')
ax1.set_title('Income vs Age (Size: Total Purchases, Color: Total Spending)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1, label='Total Spending')

spending_data = df[spending_cols].mean()

ax2.set_xlabel('Product Category')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Spending')
ax2.set_title('Average Spending by Product Category')

ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)

ax3.set_xlabel('Purchase Channel')
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Number of Purchases')
ax3.set_title('Purchase Channels Comparison')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Customer demographics pie chart
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
marital_counts.plot(kind='pie', ax=ax4, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90)
ax4.set_ylabel('')
ax4.set_title('Marital Status Distribution')

# 5. Education level distribution
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)

education_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax5, color=sns.color_palette("muted"))

ax5.set_ylabel('Count')
ax5.set_title('Education Level Distribution')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 6. Household composition
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
df['Total_Children'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']

children_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, color=sns.color_palette("coolwarm"))
ax6.set_xlabel('Number of Children')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count')
ax6.set_title('Household Children Distribution')

# 7. Recency distribution
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
ax7.hist(df['Recency'], bins=10, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7, color='skyblue')
ax7.set_xlabel('Days Since Last Purchase')
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax7.set_title('Purchase Recency Distribution')

# 8. Correlation heatmap of key metrics
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
corr_cols = ['Income', 'Age', 'Total_Spending', 'Total_Purchases', 'Recency', 'NumWebVisitsMonth']
corr_matrix = df[corr_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', 
            square=True, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, ax=ax8)
ax8.set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Key Metrics')

# 9. Web visits vs store purchases
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
ax9.scatter(df['NumWebVisitsMonth'], df['NumStorePurchases'], 
           c=df['Income'], s=100, alpha=0.7, cmap='plasma')
ax9.set_xlabel('Monthly Web Visits')
ax9.set_ylabel('Store Purchases')
ax9.set_title('Web Visits vs Store Purchases (Color: Income)')
plt.colorbar(ax9.collections[0], ax=ax9, label='Income')

plt.suptitle('Customer Data Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
